name: o-matic-server
description: Connect an agent host to the o-MATIC Server over OAuth-protected Streamable HTTP MCP. Includes a startup workflow for hosts that load plugin skills.

interface.shortDescription: Connect to your o-MATIC Server factory over SSO-protected MCP.
interface.longDescription: Connect to the cloud o-MATIC Server by default, or configure an on-premises Server endpoint. The user signs in with OAuth/SSO. The Server retains factory grants, policies, SOPs, roster, memory, audit, vault, embedding, and publishing authority.
defaultPrompt: Start the factory and show me the startup card.
Reconnect to the o-MATIC Server and refresh its tools.
